import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import httpx
ids=subprocess.check_output(["docker","compose","ps","-a","-q"],text=True).split()
containers=[]
for container in ids:
    raw=subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect","--format",'{"id":{{json .Id}},"name":{{json .Name}},"started":{{json .State.StartedAt}},"mounts":{{json .Mounts}},"health":{{json (index .State "Health")}}}',container],text=True)
    row=json.loads(raw)
    health=row.pop("health")
    row["health"]=health["Status"] if health else None
    containers.append(row)
print(json.dumps({"compose_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path("compose.yaml").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"containers":containers},indent=2))
r=httpx.get("http://127.0.0.1:18000/health/ready")
print("readiness",r.status_code,r.text)
r.raise_for_status()
